query: EXPLAIN MATCH (i:V01)-[r:INTERFACE_OF]->(p) WHERE i.uid IN ['V01:I04','V01:I05'] RETURN i.uid AS interface,p.uid AS participant,r.role AS role,r.uid AS relationshipUid,i.referenceMode AS referenceMode,i.relativePosition AS relativePosition,i.sideBoundaryMappingsJson AS sideMappings ORDER BY interface,role
